environment.nginx_version:
nginx version: nginx/1.28.0
built by gcc 13.3.0 (Ubuntu 13.3.0-6ubuntu2~24.04.1) 
configure arguments: --prefix=<RECOVERY>/scratch/nginx-build/install --without-http_gzip_module

validation.source_handoff_trace_modes: normal/-O with SIGTERM/SIGINT after actual healthy fetch at capture-return; old completed row lost, current retained
validation.nginx_handoff_tests: actual local Nginx completed network report preserved at return trace; modeled Docker command boundary separate, not actual Docker
validation.measurement_limits: worker_reaped is null without an observed slow-worker PID; file-before-drain is null outside undrained cases

sanitization: Case paths replaced by <CASE>/<REPOSITORY>; recovery namespace replaced by <RECOVERY>. Original byte hashes inside cases refer to unsanitized bytes, artifact hash to published sanitized JSON. Results, source hashes and SHAs unchanged.
publication_scope: Later docs/evidence commit; all six executable/helper/config/test hashes remain equal to tested_revision. Before runs use actual c9 source CLI plus this orchestration, not an old full-suite run.
limits: Real healthy/slow HTTP loopback and worker processes; deterministic trace-at-return injection isolates handoff, not an arbitrary-instruction or distributed-concurrency proof.

Source --output full file precedes stdout; normal summary preserved, cancellation/write-failure output is full JSON. A late publication signal can be represented by exit status rather than mutation of a frozen report.

Two-second stdout bound applies to POSIX descriptors. Full/closed stderr may drop notices; requested regular file remains the known location. Invalid destination falls back to an intentional automatic copy when possible.
Local filesystem/kernel stalls, all unavailable output destinations, custom/nonPOSIXstreams,SIGKILL/hostfailure/powerloss are outside guarantees; no fsync/durablebackup claim.
Before undrained cases require scoped SIGKILL rescue of their captured owned parent after demonstrating the hang; fetch worker reaping is independently checked.
Source/Nginx cancellation states remain separate; shared helper contains pure I/O only. All old bundles preserved.
Missing private laptop receipts/uncommitted work not recovered; no actual GoDaddy/Discord/publicTLS/DNS/actualDocker/SQL recovery/nativeapproval/merge/issueclosure established.
